2018: Complete overhaul of the page adopting a much longer, modular format with distinct headings (Innovation, Our Team, Global Community Impact, Sustainable Business Innovation). Added specific mentions of subsidiary brands (Converse, Hurley, Jordan) and corporate location in Beaverton, Oregon. Tone shifted to be more visionary and mission-driven.
2019: Renamed headings slightly (e.g., 'Global Community Impact' to 'Social & Community Impact') and updated the sustainability description to focus on protecting the future of sport and a healthy planet rather than doubling the business.
2020: Removed the Hurley brand from the listed subsidiaries and streamlined the layout by removing several subheadings while keeping the core thematic text.
2021: Major shift in vocabulary, tone, and length. The text became more conversational, culturally focused, and narrative-driven, emphasizing diversity, creativity, collaboration, failure, and personal sport journeys while dropping the corporate structure and subsidiary lists.
